rubrics.name: STAR Method
rubrics.description: Evaluates whether the answer follows the Situation-Task-Action-Result framework. A strong behavioral answer clearly describes the context, the candidate's specific responsibility, the concrete actions taken, and the measurable outcome.

situation.description: Clear description of the context, background, and setting.

task.description: Specific responsibility or challenge the candidate faced.

action.description: Concrete steps the candidate personally took.

result.description: Measurable outcome or impact of the actions.

scoring_guide.1: Answer is vague with no clear structure. Missing most STAR components.
scoring_guide.2: Answer has 1-2 STAR components but lacks specificity or completeness.
scoring_guide.3: Answer covers 3 STAR components adequately but one is weak or missing.
scoring_guide.4: Answer covers all 4 STAR components clearly with good specificity.
scoring_guide.5: Answer perfectly follows STAR with rich detail, specific metrics, and compelling narrative.

rubrics.name: Specificity
rubrics.description: Evaluates whether the answer uses concrete, specific examples rather than vague generalities. Strong answers include numbers, names, timeframes, and specific details rather than abstract statements.

scoring_guide.1: Answer is entirely vague with no specific details, numbers, or concrete examples.
scoring_guide.2: Answer has minimal specifics — one or two details but mostly general statements.
scoring_guide.3: Answer has some specific details but could be more concrete in key areas.
scoring_guide.4: Answer is mostly specific with good use of numbers, names, and concrete examples.
scoring_guide.5: Answer is highly specific throughout — rich with metrics, names, timeframes, and concrete details.

rubrics.name: Relevance
rubrics.description: Evaluates whether the answer directly addresses the question asked and stays on topic. Strong answers are tightly focused on the competency being assessed without going off on tangents.

scoring_guide.1: Answer does not address the question. Completely off-topic or misunderstood the question.
scoring_guide.2: Answer partially addresses the question but drifts significantly off-topic.
scoring_guide.3: Answer addresses the question but includes some irrelevant information.
scoring_guide.4: Answer is mostly relevant and focused on the question with minor tangents.
scoring_guide.5: Answer is perfectly relevant, directly addresses the question, and demonstrates the target competency clearly.

rubrics.name: Communication Clarity
rubrics.description: Evaluates the clarity, structure, and coherence of the answer. Strong answers are well-organized, easy to follow, use appropriate vocabulary, and avoid excessive filler words or rambling.

scoring_guide.1: Answer is very difficult to follow — disorganized, rambling, or incoherent.
scoring_guide.2: Answer has significant clarity issues — hard to follow in places.
scoring_guide.3: Answer is reasonably clear but could be better organized or more concise.
scoring_guide.4: Answer is clear and well-organized with good vocabulary.
scoring_guide.5: Answer is exceptionally clear, concise, well-structured, and compelling.

rubrics.name: Self-Awareness
rubrics.description: Evaluates whether the candidate demonstrates reflection, learning, and growth mindset. Strong answers acknowledge challenges, lessons learned, and what the candidate would do differently.

scoring_guide.1: No self-reflection. Answer presents a perfect narrative with no acknowledgment of challenges or learning.
scoring_guide.2: Minimal self-awareness — brief mention of a challenge but no real reflection.
scoring_guide.3: Some self-awareness — acknowledges a challenge or lesson but doesn't go deep.
scoring_guide.4: Good self-awareness — reflects on what was learned and how they grew.
scoring_guide.5: Excellent self-awareness — deeply reflective, acknowledges mistakes, articulates specific lessons and growth.

good.label: Good
good.description: Solid answer with minor areas for improvement.

average.label: Average
average.description: Adequate answer but needs more depth and specificity.

below_average.label: Below Average
below_average.description: Answer lacks key elements and needs significant improvement.

poor.label: Poor
poor.description: Answer does not adequately address the question.
